requirement_text: Any interface between a user and the automated system shall have a maximum response time of 5 seconds unless noted by an exception below.
requirement_text_raw: Any interface between a user and the automated system shall have a maximum response time of 5 seconds  unless noted by an exception below.'
user_story: As a user, I want any interface between me and the automated system to respond within 5 seconds, so that I am not kept waiting, except where an exception is noted.
technical_task: Enforce a maximum response time of 5 seconds on every user interface to the automated system, except where an exception is noted.
acceptance_criteria: Given an interface between a user and the automated system, when the user makes a request, then the response arrives within 5 seconds.
Given an interface with a noted exception, when the user makes a request, then the response time stated in the exception applies instead of 5 seconds.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The exceptions are said to be noted elsewhere and are not listed here.

requirement_text: The depth of the component shall be smaller than 20 millimetres.
user_story: As a hardware designer, I want the depth of the component to be smaller than 20 millimetres, so that it fits the available space.
technical_task: Design the component with a depth smaller than 20 millimetres.
acceptance_criteria: Given the component, when its depth is measured, then it is smaller than 20 millimetres.
Given a component whose depth is 20 millimetres or more, when it is checked against the requirement, then it is rejected.
rationale: Role assumed: hardware designer. The reason for the limit is inferred.

requirement_text: An HCP can add commentary to a pending lab procedure .
user_story: As an HCP, I want to add commentary to a pending lab procedure, so that my notes are attached to it.
technical_task: Allow an HCP to add commentary to a lab procedure that is pending.
acceptance_criteria: Given a pending lab procedure, when an HCP adds commentary, then the commentary is saved with the procedure.
Given a lab procedure that is no longer pending, when an HCP tries to add commentary, then the commentary is not added.
rationale: The second criterion follows from "pending".

requirement_text: The solution should provide the ability to define context based on legal requirements or disaster conditions.
user_story: As an emergency coordinator, I want to define context based on legal requirements or disaster conditions, so that the solution behaves appropriately in those situations.
technical_task: Provide a way to define context based on legal requirements or disaster conditions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a legal requirement, when the user defines a context based on it, then the context is saved.
Given disaster conditions, when the user defines a context based on them, then the context is saved.
rationale: Role assumed: emergency coordinator. What the context affects is not stated.

requirement_text: Superuser shall view users' stats to monitor website usage.
user_story: As a superuser, I want to view users' stats, so that I can monitor website usage.
technical_task: Show users' stats to the superuser for monitoring website usage.
acceptance_criteria: Given a superuser, when the superuser opens the users' stats, then the stats are shown.
Given a user who is not a superuser, when the user tries to open the stats, then access is not granted.
rationale: Role stated: superuser. The second criterion follows from "Superuser shall".

requirement_text: Encryption shall be employed by the system for all privacy-sensitive data stored on the server.
user_story: As a user, I want all privacy-sensitive data stored on the server to be encrypted, so that my private data stays protected.
technical_task: Encrypt all privacy-sensitive data stored on the server.
acceptance_criteria: Given privacy-sensitive data, when it is stored on the server, then it is encrypted.
Given encrypted stored data, when it is read without decryption, then it is not readable.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The encryption algorithm is not specified.

requirement_text: Set the test level Ucal1 between DUT port A and DUT port B with the closed loop method.
rationale: The sentence is a test instruction that uses terms not defined in the text.
clarification_questions: What do Ucal1, DUT port A and DUT port B refer to?
What is the closed loop method, and who performs this test?

requirement_text: As an option the contractor shall present concepts with smaller batteries and other different power supplies.
user_story: As a client, I want the contractor to present concepts with smaller batteries and other different power supplies as an option, so that I can consider alternatives.
technical_task: Prepare and present optional concepts that use smaller batteries and other different power supplies.
acceptance_criteria: Given the contractor's concepts, when they are presented, then an option with smaller batteries is included.
Given the contractor's concepts, when they are presented, then an option with other different power supplies is included.
rationale: Role assumed: client. "Smaller" is relative to a baseline that is not given.

requirement_text: System shall identify each thermostat using unique identifiers.
user_story: As a homeowner, I want each thermostat to be identified by a unique identifier, so that I can tell them apart.
technical_task: Assign every thermostat a unique identifier and use it to identify the thermostat.
acceptance_criteria: Given a thermostat added to the system, when it is registered, then it receives an identifier.
Given two thermostats, when their identifiers are compared, then they are different.
rationale: Role assumed: homeowner.

requirement_text: The system shall encrypt sensitive data before sending it over insecure connections like the internet.
user_story: As a user, I want sensitive data encrypted before it is sent over insecure connections such as the internet, so that others cannot read it.
technical_task: Encrypt sensitive data before sending it over insecure connections like the internet.
acceptance_criteria: Given sensitive data to be sent over the internet, when it is sent, then it is encrypted first.
Given data sent over an insecure connection, when it is intercepted, then it cannot be read in plain form.
rationale: Role assumed: user.

requirement_text: Administrator shall have authority to set rules, regulations, and policies.
user_story: As an administrator, I want authority to set rules, regulations and policies, so that I can govern how the system is used.
technical_task: Give administrators the ability to create and set rules, regulations and policies.
acceptance_criteria: Given an administrator, when the administrator sets a rule, regulation or policy, then it is saved.
Given a user who is not an administrator, when the user tries to set a policy, then the action is not allowed.
rationale: Role stated: administrator. The second criterion follows from "Administrator shall have authority".

requirement_text: System shall maintain the book status as Rejected/Canceled if the administrator rejects the requested book.
user_story: As a library user, I want the book status to remain Rejected/Canceled when the administrator rejects my request, so that I can see my request was declined.
technical_task: Keep the book status as Rejected/Canceled when the administrator rejects the requested book.
acceptance_criteria: Given a requested book, when the administrator rejects the request, then the book status is Rejected/Canceled.
Given a rejected request, when the user views the book status, then it still shows Rejected/Canceled.
rationale: Role assumed: library user.

requirement_text: The FTSS shall configure each ICP to perform IBIT Minimum Processing Environment (MPE) Tests, Power-up Tests, and Initial BIT on each ICP, as shown inTable 3.2-3.
requirement_text_raw: The FTSS shall [SRS287] configure each ICP to perform IBIT Minimum Processing Environment (MPE) Tests, Power-up Tests, and Initial BIT on each ICP, as shown inTable 3.2-3.
user_story: As a system integrator, I want the FTSS to configure each ICP to perform the MPE Tests, Power-up Tests and Initial BIT, so that the ICPs are tested as shown in Table 3.2-3.
technical_task: Configure each ICP to perform IBIT Minimum Processing Environment (MPE) Tests, Power-up Tests and Initial BIT, as shown in Table 3.2-3.
acceptance_criteria: Given an ICP, when the FTSS configures it, then it is set to perform the MPE Tests, Power-up Tests and Initial BIT.
Given the configured tests, when they are compared with Table 3.2-3, then they match the table.
rationale: Role assumed: system integrator. The table contents are not given.

requirement_text: The solution should have a standard interface to a send required medication data to a variety of EHR's or CDR for access by clinicians involved in the inmate’s care.
user_story: As a clinician, I want a standard interface to send required medication data to a variety of EHRs or CDRs, so that clinicians caring for an inmate can access it.
technical_task: Provide a standard interface that sends required medication data to a variety of EHRs or CDRs for access by the clinicians involved in the inmate's care.
acceptance_criteria: Given required medication data, when it is sent through the standard interface, then it reaches an EHR or CDR.
Given medication data in an EHR or CDR, when a clinician involved in the inmate's care opens it, then the clinician can access the data.
rationale: Role assumed: clinician. EHR and CDR are kept as written.

requirement_text: Select 'History' at the top of the page to view a summary of the patients Medical History and Lifestyle information.
user_story: As a clinician, I want to select History at the top of the page to see a summary of the patient's Medical History and Lifestyle information, so that I can review the patient's background.
technical_task: Add a History option at the top of the page that shows a summary of the patient's Medical History and Lifestyle information.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient page, when the clinician selects History at the top, then a summary of the patient's Medical History and Lifestyle information is shown.
Given the summary is shown, when the clinician reads it, then it contains Medical History and Lifestyle information.
rationale: Role assumed: clinician.

requirement_text: The FTPP spare hardware shall include one (1) radiation hardened FTPP set (5 NEs) and three (3) individual NEs including all optical connects, cables, and required accessories which are flight certified to meet the requirements specified herein for the X-38 space flight vehicles.
requirement_text_raw: The FTPP spare hardware shall (3.1.28) include one (1) radiation hardened FTPP set (5 NEs) and three (3) individual NEs including all optical connects, cables, and required accessories which are flight certified to meet the requirements specified herein for the X-38 space flight vehicles.
user_story: As a mission manager, I want the FTPP spare hardware to include one (1) radiation hardened FTPP set (5 NEs) and three (3) individual NEs with all accessories, so that spares are ready for the X-38 flights.
technical_task: Supply FTPP spare hardware consisting of one (1) radiation hardened FTPP set (5 NEs) and three (3) individual NEs, including all optical connects, cables and required accessories, flight certified for the X-38 space flight vehicles.
acceptance_criteria: Given the FTPP spare hardware, when it is inventoried, then it includes one (1) radiation hardened FTPP set of 5 NEs.
Given the FTPP spare hardware, when it is inventoried, then it includes three (3) individual NEs with all optical connects, cables and required accessories.
Given the spare hardware, when its certification is checked, then it is flight certified to meet the requirements for the X-38 space flight vehicles.
rationale: Role assumed: mission manager.

requirement_text: The Test Manager shall be familiar with the details of the progress and results of the tests over all integration levels and answer to the client on these issues.
rationale: "Familiar with the details" is a personal attribute that cannot be tested as stated.
clarification_questions: What level of familiarity counts as "familiar with the details"?
How is the Test Manager's reporting to the client verified?

requirement_text: The solution should use notification message provides appropriate privacy and security notices (based on associated privacy and security policies or summaries) and remains on the screen until the user takes explicit actions to log on to the information solution.
user_story: As a user, I want a notification message with privacy and security notices to stay on the screen until I explicitly log on, so that I have seen the notices before using the solution.
technical_task: Show a notification message with the appropriate privacy and security notices that remains on screen until the user takes an explicit action to log on.
acceptance_criteria: Given the log-on screen, when it is displayed, then a notification message with privacy and security notices is shown.
Given the notification message is shown, when the user has not taken an explicit action to log on, then the message stays on the screen.
Given the notification message is shown, when the user takes an explicit action to log on, then the message may be dismissed.
rationale: Role assumed: user. Which policies the notices are based on is not stated.

requirement_text: User shall be able to complete transactions, including managing the shopping cart.
user_story: As a shopper, I want to complete transactions, including managing the shopping cart, so that I can buy what I need.
technical_task: Support completing transactions, including managing the shopping cart.
acceptance_criteria: Given items in the shopping cart, when the user manages the cart, then the items can be changed.
Given a cart, when the user completes the transaction, then the transaction is completed.
rationale: Role assumed: shopper.

requirement_text: User shall have the option to customize the layout and appearance of their Gmail inbox.
user_story: As a Gmail user, I want to customize the layout and appearance of my inbox, so that it looks the way I prefer.
technical_task: Provide options to customize the layout and appearance of the Gmail inbox.
acceptance_criteria: Given the inbox, when the user changes a layout option, then the inbox layout is updated.
Given the inbox, when the user changes an appearance option, then the inbox appearance is updated.
rationale: Role assumed: Gmail user.

requirement_text: User shall be able to create an account to access additional features and create their own profile.
user_story: As a visitor, I want to create an account, so that I can access additional features and have my own profile.
technical_task: Allow users to create an account that unlocks additional features and a personal profile.
acceptance_criteria: Given a visitor without an account, when the visitor creates an account, then the account is created.
Given a signed-in account holder, when the user opens their profile, then their own profile is shown with the additional features available.
rationale: Role assumed: visitor.

requirement_text: The database backup shall be continuously maintained and updated for reliability.
rationale: "Continuously" and "for reliability" are not defined enough to test.
clarification_questions: What does "continuously" mean: real time or a fixed interval?
What reliability target should the backup support?

requirement_text: System shall require authorization for project admins before they can access the admin interface to manage project sites.
user_story: As a project admin, I want to be required to get authorization before accessing the admin interface, so that only authorized admins manage project sites.
technical_task: Require authorization for project admins before they can access the admin interface for managing project sites.
acceptance_criteria: Given a project admin who is authorized, when the admin opens the admin interface, then access is granted.
Given a project admin who is not authorized, when the admin opens the admin interface, then access is denied.
rationale: Role stated: project admin.

requirement_text: Filtering options by date, instrument, or trade type shall be available.
user_story: As a trader, I want filtering options by date, instrument or trade type, so that I can find the trades I need.
technical_task: Provide filters by date, instrument and trade type.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of items, when the user filters by date, then only items matching the date are shown.
Given a list of items, when the user filters by instrument or trade type, then only matching items are shown.
rationale: Role assumed: trader.

requirement_text: In this regard the front cover provides the black panel effect (e.g. by tuned transparency and black panel masking) and it provides an even front surface of the component (e.g. by a front cover larger than the display module and an even joint between trim ring and front cover).
user_story: As a product designer, I want the front cover to give a black panel effect and an even front surface, so that the component looks uniform.
technical_task: Design the front cover with tuned transparency and black panel masking for the black panel effect, and make it larger than the display module with an even joint between trim ring and front cover.
acceptance_criteria: Given the front cover, when it is viewed, then it provides the black panel effect.
Given the front cover and the component, when the front surface is inspected, then the surface is even.
rationale: Role assumed: product designer. The means in the brackets are examples in the requirement.

requirement_text: The system shall support the display of all user interface text elements in both English and Dutch.
user_story: As a user, I want all user interface text to be displayed in English or Dutch, so that I can use the application in my language.
technical_task: Support English and Dutch for all user interface text elements.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user selects English, when a screen is displayed, then all text elements are in English.
Given the user selects Dutch, when a screen is displayed, then all text elements are in Dutch.
rationale: Role assumed: user. How the language is selected is not stated.

requirement_text: The application must be able to link up with the INTERNAL system in order for users to properly log in and be identified.
user_story: As a user, I want the application to link up with the INTERNAL system, so that I can log in and be identified properly.
technical_task: Connect the application to the INTERNAL system for login and user identification.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user with an account in the INTERNAL system, when the user logs in, then the application links up with the INTERNAL system.
Given a successful link to the INTERNAL system, when login completes, then the user is identified.
rationale: Role assumed: user.

requirement_text: System shall validate the entered OTP.
user_story: As a user, I want the entered OTP to be validated, so that only a correct code lets me proceed.
technical_task: Validate the OTP entered by the user.
acceptance_criteria: Given a correct OTP, when the user enters it, then it is accepted.
Given an incorrect OTP, when the user enters it, then it is rejected.
rationale: Role assumed: user.

requirement_text: The details of the windings shall be designed by the supplier.
user_story: As a project manager, I want the details of the windings to be designed by the supplier, so that design responsibility is clear.
technical_task: Assign the design of the winding details to the supplier.
acceptance_criteria: Given the component's windings, when the design is produced, then the details of the windings are designed by the supplier.
Given the winding details, when the design is delivered, then it comes from the supplier.
rationale: Role assumed: project manager.

requirement_text: The system shall process and display the changed user information.
user_story: As a user, I want changed user information to be processed and displayed, so that I can see my updates.
technical_task: Process changes to user information and display the changed information.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user changes their information, when the change is submitted, then it is processed.
Given the change has been processed, when the user views their information, then the changed information is displayed.
rationale: Role assumed: user.

requirement_text: The system shall provide features for adjusting font size, background color, and text-to-speech functionality.
user_story: As a user with visual needs, I want to adjust font size and background color and use text-to-speech, so that I can read the content comfortably.
technical_task: Provide settings for font size, background color and text-to-speech.
acceptance_criteria: Given the settings, when the user changes the font size, then the text is displayed in the chosen size.
Given the settings, when the user changes the background color, then the background shows the chosen color.
Given text on a screen, when the user turns on text-to-speech, then the text is read aloud.
rationale: Role assumed: user with visual needs; the requirement names the three features.

requirement_text: User shall be able to create, update, and delete archival descriptions in their repository.
user_story: As an archivist, I want to create, update and delete archival descriptions in my repository, so that I can keep them current.
technical_task: Implement create, update and delete operations for archival descriptions in the user's repository.
acceptance_criteria: Given a repository, when the user creates an archival description, then it is saved in the repository.
Given an archival description, when the user updates it, then the changes are saved.
Given an archival description, when the user deletes it, then it is removed from the repository.
rationale: Role assumed: archivist.

requirement_text: The system shall be built such that it is as secure as possible from malicious interference.
requirement_text_raw: The system shall be built such that it is as secure as possible from malicious interference.'
rationale: "As secure as possible" has no measurable target.
clarification_questions: What level of security counts as "as secure as possible"?
Which kinds of malicious interference must be prevented?

requirement_text: User shall utilize the screen recorder function with a facial tracker to capture live movements.
user_story: As a user, I want to use a screen recorder with a facial tracker, so that I can capture live movements.
technical_task: Provide a screen recorder function that works together with a facial tracker to capture live movements.
acceptance_criteria: Given the screen recorder function, when the user starts it, then the facial tracker is used.
Given a recording in progress, when the user moves, then the live movements are captured.
rationale: Role assumed: user.

requirement_text: The HCP is notified of drug allergy.
user_story: As a physician, I want to be notified of a drug allergy, so that I can avoid prescribing a harmful drug.
technical_task: Notify the HCP when a drug allergy applies.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient with a known drug allergy, when the allergy applies, then the HCP is notified.
Given a patient with no known drug allergy, when the HCP works with the record, then no allergy notification appears.
rationale: Role assumed: physician; the requirement says HCP. The trigger for the notification is not specified.

requirement_text: System shall support EAD import functionality accessible from the frontend.
user_story: As an archivist, I want EAD import functionality accessible from the frontend, so that I can import EAD data without other tools.
technical_task: Expose the EAD import function in the frontend.
acceptance_criteria: Given the frontend, when the user looks for import options, then the EAD import function is available.
Given an EAD file, when the user imports it from the frontend, then the data is imported.
rationale: Role assumed: archivist.

requirement_text: The system shall integrate with various data analysis and storage platforms.
rationale: "Various platforms" are not named, so the integration scope is unknown.
clarification_questions: Which data analysis and storage platforms must be supported?
What kind of integration (import, export, API) is expected?

requirement_text: The system shall show who submitted each estimate in the current round.
user_story: As a team member, I want to see who submitted each estimate in the current round, so that I know who has contributed.
technical_task: Show the name of the submitter next to each estimate in the current round.
acceptance_criteria: Given estimates submitted in the current round, when the round is displayed, then each estimate shows who submitted it.
Given a new estimate is submitted, when the round is displayed, then the new estimate shows its submitter.
rationale: Role assumed: team member.

requirement_text: The system shall allow administrators to delete restaurant types, removing them from the list.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to delete restaurant types, so that they are removed from the list.
technical_task: Allow administrators to delete restaurant types and remove them from the list.
acceptance_criteria: Given a restaurant type in the list, when an administrator deletes it, then it is removed from the list.
Given a user who is not an administrator, when the user tries to delete a restaurant type, then it is not deleted.
rationale: Role stated: administrator.

requirement_text: The system shall utilize AI to analyze surroundings and select the appropriate lens based on the analysis.
user_story: As a photographer, I want the system to analyze the surroundings and select the appropriate lens, so that I get a suitable lens without choosing it myself.
technical_task: Use AI to analyze the surroundings and select the appropriate lens based on the analysis.
acceptance_criteria: Given a scene, when the system analyzes the surroundings, then the analysis is produced using AI.
Given the analysis, when the system selects a lens, then the lens chosen is the one the analysis found appropriate.
rationale: Role assumed: photographer. The selection criteria are not stated.

requirement_text: Communication services shall provide the capability to "broadcast" messages to all virtual groups.
requirement_text_raw: Communication services shall [SRS049] provide the capability to "broadcast" messages to all virtual groups.
user_story: As a software developer, I want communication services to broadcast messages to all virtual groups, so that one message reaches every group.
technical_task: Provide a broadcast capability in communication services that sends a message to all virtual groups.
acceptance_criteria: Given several virtual groups, when a message is broadcast, then every virtual group receives it.
Given a broadcast message, when it is sent, then it is sent in a single operation.
rationale: Role assumed: software developer. The second criterion is an interpretation of "broadcast".

requirement_text: An internet connection is recommended for the system. (Note: This is a recommendation, not a requirement, so it's not converted to "shall".)
rationale: The text itself says this is a recommendation and not a requirement.
clarification_questions: Is an internet connection required, recommended or optional?
What should the system do when there is no connection?

requirement_text: User shall be able to see how many seats are left for a summit, to ensure timely registration.
user_story: As an attendee, I want to see how many seats are left for a summit, so that I can register in time.
technical_task: Display the number of remaining seats for each summit.
acceptance_criteria: Given a summit with seats left, when a user views the summit, then the number of seats left is shown.
Given a seat is taken, when the summit is viewed again, then the number of seats left is reduced.
rationale: Role assumed: attendee.

requirement_text: System shall provide timely responses to user inputs.
rationale: "Timely" has no measurable limit.
clarification_questions: Which user inputs does this cover?

requirement_text: User shall be able to add a new (unique) specialty.
user_story: As a clinic administrator, I want to add a new unique specialty, so that the list of specialties can grow.
technical_task: Allow users to add a new specialty and prevent duplicates.
acceptance_criteria: Given a specialty name that does not exist, when the user adds it, then the new specialty is saved.
Given a specialty name that already exists, when the user adds it, then the addition is refused.
rationale: Role assumed: clinic administrator.

requirement_text: Account balance display time must not exceed 2 seconds under normal workload and 3 seconds under peak workload.
user_story: As a customer, I want the account balance to be displayed within 2 seconds under normal workload and 3 seconds under peak workload, so that I see my balance quickly.
technical_task: Limit account balance display time to 2 seconds under normal workload and 3 seconds under peak workload.
acceptance_criteria: Given a normal workload, when the account balance is displayed, then the display time does not exceed 2 seconds.
Given a peak workload, when the account balance is displayed, then the display time does not exceed 3 seconds.
rationale: Role assumed: customer. Normal and peak workload are not defined.

requirement_text: The Appointments Report ('Reports > Visits > Appointments') gives you a list of appointments for a given provider or for all providers in a specified date range.
requirement_text_raw: The Appointments Report ('Reports > Visits > Appointments') gives you a list of appointments for a given provider  or for all providers  in a specified date range.
user_story: As a practice manager, I want an Appointments Report listing appointments for a provider or for all providers in a date range, so that I can review the schedule.
technical_task: Provide an Appointments Report under Reports > Visits > Appointments that lists appointments for a given provider or all providers in a specified date range.
acceptance_criteria: Given a provider and a date range, when the report is run, then the appointments of that provider in the range are listed.
Given the option for all providers and a date range, when the report is run, then the appointments of all providers in the range are listed.
rationale: Role assumed: practice manager.

requirement_text: The user shall be able to search by price and destination, entering integers for their desired values, and be informed if they enter an invalid input.
user_story: As a traveler, I want to search by price and destination and be told when an input is invalid, so that I can correct it.
technical_task: Implement search by price and destination using integer inputs, and show an error message for invalid input.
acceptance_criteria: Given integer values for price and destination, when the user searches, then matching results are shown.
Given an invalid input, when the user submits the search, then the user is informed that the input is invalid.
rationale: Role assumed: traveler. How a destination is expressed as an integer is not stated.

requirement_text: Users shall be able to set their usernames for data discoverability.
user_story: As a user, I want to set my username, so that my data can be discovered.
technical_task: Allow users to set their usernames and use them for data discoverability.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user, when the user sets a username, then the username is saved.
Given a saved username, when other users look for data, then the data can be found by the username.
rationale: Role assumed: user. Who may search is not stated.

requirement_text: The system shall be able to handle a high volume of form submissions without performance degradation.
rationale: "High volume" and "performance degradation" are not quantified.
clarification_questions: What number of form submissions counts as "a high volume"?
What degree of slowdown is acceptable?
